name: wamr
description: WebAssembly Micro Runtime (WAMR) - interpreter (fast/classic), AOT, Fast-JIT selectable

aot.description: Enable AOT runtime (requires wamrc to pre-compile .wasm -> .aot)

classic-interp.description: Use classic interpreter instead of fast interpreter (saves ~2x memory, ~0.5x speed)

fast-jit.description: Enable Fast JIT (asmjit/zydis, ~50% of AOT speed, fast startup). Not supported on Windows.
